scientific_integrity: An exact finite-state proof using a 64-vertex transfer graph and a standalone exhaustive checker. Correctness and originality assessed in same-model review only; independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only the labelled graph \(C_n\square K_2\) with \(n\ge3\) and perfect edge domination of unselected edges is covered.
No enumeration modulo automorphisms or extension to Möbius/open ladders is claimed.
Potential prior equivalence remains a historical-priority risk: full remaining text of the initiating 2026 paper was not accessible during review.
title: Exact perfect-edge-domination polynomial of \(C_n\square K_2\)
